evidence: Carries the Mining label and moves getblocktemplate caching state into BlockTemplateManager (src/node/block_template_manager.cpp).
rationale: Eliminating process-wide function-local static variables cleans up template cache lifetime and adds proper thread-safety annotations. As noted in the description, cached `CBlockIndex*` pointers could outlive `ChainstateManager` in test environments, and moving this state into `BlockTemplateManager` enables unit testing and supports tracking issue #33758 to unify template caching across RPC and IPC mining.
